assumption: Mature thread availability does not establish fresh thread assignment availability.
basis: Fresh original SVC13/true-LR returns success; independently controlled unbound/bound replay and repeated native assign/free distinguish state.
dependent-result: Per-thread slot lifecycle and validation ordering.
stress-test: Existing assignment, assign/query/free, same/different scheduler owner and all four caller profiles.
falsification-probe: Fresh/mature sequence or binding state does not explain status differences.
status: confirmed; initial mature-only unavailability hypothesis falsified

assumption: Private action/handle/slot layout is ULONG plus two aligned pointer fields, native24B and WoW12B.
basis: Four producer profiles initialize exact native24B and WoW12B records; explicit native4B padding and WoW4B outside-record tail survive all 39488 cases.
stress-test: Native/WoW lengths, alignment, padding, aliases and guards.
falsification-probe: Actual compatibility converter uses another length/layout or copy ordering.

assumption: A guest slot must own a real mapping and correct lifetime, rather than substitute success or mature NOT_SUPPORTED.
basis: Four-profile mapping/lifetime/pool/capacity captures: 8192B reservation, 64B slots, 128 capacity, pagewise commitment, binding retains owner, final close/exit release, free retains bytes and assignment zeros them.
dependent-result: Object references, VM mapping, thread binding/cleanup and output publication.
stress-test: Whole-page contents, repeated assignment/query/free, handle close, thread exit and process drain.
falsification-probe: Native lifetime or reached consumer depends on unmodeled slot data/state.
status: confirmed for captured lifecycle; ongoing kernel timing/counter updates unknown

assumption: Observed kernel/DLL behavior is bounded to build29683.1000 on ARM64 and selected compatibility callers.
stress-test: Physical x64 kernel and other builds.
falsification-probe: Another selected build yields different ordering or map ownership.
status: retained; physical x64 kernel and other kernel/DLL builds unknown
